description: Use this for a backdrop colour such as "Black": rarity and observed prices. With a collection it gives that collection's backdrop; without one it lists every collection where the backdrop appears. Do not use it for models or symbols. The Telegram ask is a TON price (telegram_ask_ton); telegram_ask_stars is that ask at the display rate, approximate.
name: get_backdrop

anyOf.description: Approximate: the TON ask converted to Stars at the display rate, NOT a price payable in Stars. Equals the ask itself only when Telegram lists it in Stars (then telegram_ask_ton is null). Quote telegram_ask_ton as the ask.
The lowest Telegram ask in TON (the price a buyer pays); null when none is known or only a Stars ask exists.

title: Get a gift backdrop
